_comment: DRAFT 2026-10-12 (wave 4), from Jetpacks' untrusted listings. Most untrusted listings pointed at the right product and only the size (one-size FJ, Big Bang, badder and diamond products) was read below 0.9; those are handled by reading examples (data/reading_examples.json 'jetpacks'). This plan adds what stores sell and the catalog lacked: strains of the strain-less site formats (Powdered Donuts, Jetfuel, badder, diamonds) and the Big Bang Mini Cosmic Starburst, each from store listings naming it. Curated entries survive storefront re-pushes. Not written: apply with --write after approval.
